newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Nigeria LNG denies Portugal natgas report.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria LNG denies Portugal natgas report.

text.p: Nigeria LNG, a unit of Royal Dutch/Shell Group, denied a Portuguese newspaper report that it was in talks to sell natural gas to state gas company Transgas.
"Negotiations have not even started and certainly are not at any stage where we can say that we are discussing with them," a spokesman for Nigeria LNG told Reuters in Lagos.
Diario de Noticias newspaper reported on Friday that Transgas was negotiating to buy 500 million cubic metres a year of Nigerian natural gas from Shell.

The paper said that Transgas president Elias da Costa had told Prime Minister Antonio Guterres that it was necessary to raise the strategic reserve period for natural gas supplies to 90 days from the present 20 days.
